response_property_constraints.description: Amadeus Property Code must be exactly 8 characters consisting of uppercase letters A-Z and digits 0-9, matching pattern ^[A-Z0-9]{8}$.
Brand or Merchant code must be exactly 2 uppercase letters, matching pattern ^[A-Z]{2}$.
Brand code must be exactly 2 uppercase letters, matching pattern ^[A-Z]{2}$.
The IATA city code must be exactly 3 uppercase letters, matching pattern ^[A-Z]{3}$.
The data type must be the enumerated value 'hotel-offer'.
Offer id must be 2 to 100 characters long and contain only uppercase letters A-Z and digits 0-9, matching pattern ^[A-Z0-9]*$.
Check-in date must follow the format YYYY-MM-DD.
Check-out date must follow the format YYYY-MM-DD and the lowest accepted value is checkInDate+1.
Special Rate provider response code must be exactly 3 characters consisting of uppercase letters, digits, or '*', matching pattern ^[A-Z0-9*]{3}$.
The estimated rate family code must match pattern [A-Z0-9]{3} (3 uppercase letters or digits).
The rate type must be one of P (public), N (negotiated), or C (conditional), matching pattern [PNC].
Room type code must be exactly 3 characters consisting of uppercase letters, digits, or '*', matching pattern ^[A-Z0-9*]{3}$.
Number of adult guests per room must be an integer between 1 and 9 inclusive.
Each child age must be an integer between 0 and 20 inclusive.
Payment type must be one of the enumerated values: GUARANTEE, DEPOSIT, PREPAY, HOLDTIME, guarantee, deposit, prepay, holdtime.
Cancellation type must be the enumerated value FULL_STAY.
Number of nights due as fee in case of cancellation must be a non-negative integer (minimum 0).
Cancellation deadline must be a datetime in ISO 8601 format (e.g. 2010-08-14T12:00:00+01:00 or 2010-08-14T12:00:00Z).
Price variation period begin date must follow format YYYY-MM-DD.
Price variation period end date must follow format YYYY-MM-DD.
Tax currency must be a monetary unit code of length between 1 and 3 characters.
Each accepted credit card type must be exactly 2 uppercase letters, matching pattern ^[A-Z]{2}$.

request_response_constraints.description: The hotelId of each returned hotel must be one of the Amadeus property codes provided in the 'hotelIds' request parameter.
request_response_constraints.corresponding_attribute_description: Amadeus property codes on 8 chars. Mandatory parameter for a search by predefined list of hotels.

request_response_constraints.description: The number of adults in each offer's guests must equal the 'adults' value supplied in the request.
request_response_constraints.corresponding_attribute_description: Number of adult guests (1-9) per room.

request_response_constraints.description: The roomQuantity in each offer must equal the 'roomQuantity' value supplied in the request.
When the 'paymentPolicy' request parameter is set to a specific value other than NONE (e.g. GUARANTEE), the paymentType of each returned offer's policies must match that value (case-insensitive).
request_response_constraints.corresponding_attribute_description: Filter the response based on a specific payment type. NONE means all types (default).
